titre: Changing schools during the school year (moving, certificat de radiation)
resume: Moving your child to a new primary school, middle school (collège) or high school (lycée) mid-year in Réunion: certificat de radiation, town hall approval, documents to provide, and the case of separated parents.
aQuoiCaSert: After a move or a separation, your child can change schools during the year. The change is never automatic: there must be a place available at the new school. The previous school gives you a certificat de radiation (certificate of withdrawal from the school roll), without which the new enrollment is not possible. For a public nursery or primary school, the town hall (mairie) must first give its approval and issue a registration certificate (certificat d'inscription).
quiEstConcerne: Parents moving during the school year, within the same town or to another town on the island.
Separated parents whose child changes main residence.
Parents who want a different school, collège or lycée from the one in their catchment area.
aSavoir: Public school in the same town: the mayor's approval is needed, and the town hall issues a registration certificate. In another town: you need the approval of the mayor of your town of residence and of the mayor of the receiving town, who issues the certificate.

Separated parents: if one parent objects to the change of school, the principal must wait for the decision of the family court judge (juge aux affaires familiales, JAF) to whom that parent has applied. A written agreement from both parents who hold parental authority avoids this deadlock.
If a judgment gives you sole parental authority, show it to the town hall and the school: you then decide alone.

Public collège or lycée in your catchment area: ask the previous school for the certificat de radiation (exeat), then enroll the child at the new one. Enrollment depends on available places and must be accepted by the head of the school. If there are no places left, the departmental services of the Éducation nationale (the national education system) assign the student.
Public collège or lycée outside your catchment area: you first need the approval of the director of education services (Dasen, directeur académique) before enrolling.
Private school: the conditions depend on the school; contact its office directly.

documents.libelle: Certificat de radiation from the previous school (exeat for collège and lycée)
documents.detail: Original given by the previous school's management when you report that your child is leaving. Required in all cases.

documents.libelle: Registration certificate issued by the town hall (public school)
documents.detail: Original, issued by the town hall of the receiving town.

documents.libelle: Family record book (livret de famille) or extract of the child's birth certificate
documents.detail: Copy, to prove identity and parentage. The birth certificate can be requested free of charge online or from the town hall where the child was born.
Copy of the vaccination pages of the health record book or a certificate of contraindication. The list depends on the child's year of birth.
Copy of a bill or rent receipt at the new address. Requested in particular by collèges and lycées.

documents.libelle: This year's report cards and guidance decision (collège, lycée)
documents.detail: Copies, often downloadable from the school's online portal.
Filled in with both parents' contact details. Requested by the collège or lycée.

documents.libelle: Written agreement of the other parent
documents.detail: Dated and signed, with a copy of their ID. Recommended when parental authority is shared.

documents.libelle: Judgment or agreement (child's residence, parental authority)
documents.detail: Copy, if a decision sets the residence or gives parental authority to one parent only.

etapes.titre: Check that there is a place left
etapes.detail: Call the new school. For a public school, also contact the town hall's school services department.
Registration certificate from the town hall for a public school. Approval from the director of education services for a collège or lycée outside your catchment area.

etapes.titre: Inform the previous school that your child is leaving
etapes.detail: Ask for the certificat de radiation or exeat, and inform the other parent in writing.

Certificat de radiation, town hall registration certificate, family record book or birth certificate, vaccination record, proof of address, report cards, written agreement of the other parent or judgment if needed.
With the management of the new school or the school office. Remember to re-enroll your child in the canteen, after-school care and school transport.

ou.nom: Town hall of your new town (school services)
ou.detail: Registration certificate for a public nursery or primary school.

ou.nom: Académie de La Réunion (regional education authority)
ou.detail: Departmental services of the Éducation nationale: placement in a collège or lycée when the school is full, or a request outside your catchment area.
Exeat, enrollment file and documents requested.
